content_text:
Thanks Roger and David! You helped me put things in the right perspective. Mine it’s the usual beginner mindset (“
this thing makes the job easier , so it must be some kind of cheating, the masters will cover me in pitch and feathers and send me away as an heretic because i took the easiest road..
” Well, i think you got the idea). We live in an era in which AI is
ruining
changing everything and i’m here wondering if it’s right or not to use white balance as a way to obtain the right mood instead of colored lights and colored gels for a micro production like mine…
